parents.subject: European Union Studies
parents.course: The EU in a Global Context

ns2:section.sectionText: This graduate-level seminar concerns European and European Union interests in global perspective. The course examines European Union global influence by exploring EU foreign policy, EU interactions with other countries and international organizations, the EU-US transatlantic relationship, and transnational civil society networks involving various European actors. Undergraduates need prior approval from instructor to register for this course. Not intended for undergrad.
